toolArguments.prompt: Create exactly ONE new native complete building game sprite. Compact ONE STOREY ordinary small dwelling, footprint6.4x4.6 total height3.8 candidate meters. Low wall/eave height2.7, dark-gray tiled gable roof, short modest front porch over offset real timber door on near road-facing face (right of center per guide), limited one/two shallow entry steps. Light gray plaster, restrained warm brick/wood trim, domestic separate windows. Not luxury villa, no second floor/dormer/attic windows; no shrunken multistorey building. Reference1 is GEOMETRY ONLY, exact footprint/camera/near-face door location, not proxy colors/lines/text. Reference2 approved TR32 local painterly style ONLY, ignore its old camera/buildings/roads and vegetation. Original supplemental building under approved style, not a source crop replication. Fixed orthographic elevation62.5 azimuth45, frontage u screen -28.486deg, depth n +55.406deg, all vertical walls screen-vertical. Match drawn two base directions, not generic30deg isometric. Japanese daytime urban anime thick-painted style, summarized brush planes, soft upper-left daylight, restrained neutral shading; not photoreal or flat heavy-outline icon. Genuine compact single-storey scale, clearly legible real door. Fully inside frame with safe margin including eaves, base and steps; request1536x1536 true transparent RGBA. ONLY building and necessary small steps, no broad ground slab/patch, lawn, trees, roof trees, people, vehicles, roads, neighboring buildings, sky, text/logos/labels, glowing windows/night light, yellow wash, global blue tint or large baked shadow. Do not use transparency as a doorway or copy guide annotations. No rotate/mirror/shear old sprites.
